goal: Add a frontend telemetry client that captures errors/crashes (window.onerror, unhandledrejection, React ErrorBoundary) and usage analytics (session_start/end with duration, page_view per route, interaction on data-telemetry clicks), batched + resilient, flushing to POST /telemetry/errors and /telemetry/events (mock-server).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: npm test + npm run lint + tsc -b all green
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: npm test && npm run lint && npx tsc -b

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A captured error produces the correct payload {message, stack, kind, path, appVersion, userAgent, occurredAt}
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest: telemetry.test.ts asserts payload shape for window.onerror / unhandledrejection

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A route change emits a page_view event; a click on a [data-telemetry] element emits an interaction event; session_start/session_end carry durationMs
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest: telemetry.test.ts drives trackPageView, dispatches click on data-telemetry node, and session lifecycle

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Events are sent in a batch and a network failure does not propagate an exception
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest: mock fetch rejecting → flush() resolves without throwing; mock resolving → one batched POST with N events

acceptance_criteria.criterion: React ErrorBoundary: a render error shows the fallback UI and reports the error
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest: ErrorBoundary.test.tsx renders a throwing child → fallback visible + captureError called

acceptance_criteria.criterion: mock-server responds 202 {accepted:true} on POST /telemetry/errors and POST /telemetry/events
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: curl/supertest both endpoints OR Playwright network assertion sees 202

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Playwright: navigating between pages + clicking emits POST /telemetry/events; forcing an error emits POST /telemetry/errors
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: e2e/telemetry.spec.ts asserts the POST requests + response 202

tasks.desc: mock-server: routes/telemetry.js with POST /telemetry/errors and /telemetry/events → 202 {accepted:true}; register in server.js

src/lib/telemetry.ts: queue+batch flush, debounce, queue cap, resilient send (no throw); sessionId, appVersion, user identity setter; events session_start/session_end(durationMs)/page_view/interaction; captureError payload; global window.onerror + unhandledrejection + data-telemetry delegated click listeners; initTelemetry()
src/components/ErrorBoundary.tsx: app-level class boundary, fallback UI + captureError(kind:'react')
Wire into app: initTelemetry() in main.tsx; ErrorBoundary wrap + TelemetryRouteListener (useLocation page_view + useAuth user) in App.tsx; add data-telemetry to a few key nav/action elements
vitest: telemetry.test.ts (error payload, page_view, interaction, session duration, batch send, network-failure no-throw) + ErrorBoundary.test.tsx (fallback + report)
e2e/telemetry.spec.ts (smoke): navigate+click → POST /telemetry/events 202; force error → POST /telemetry/errors 202
docs: short note in specs/ or telemetry.ts header documenting what is captured (privacy)
